bitterroot.name: Bitterroot River
bitterroot.message: Hoot owl restrictions (prohibits angling between 2 PM to midnight) are in effect for the Bitterroot River from Veteran's Bridge in Hamilton to the confluence with the Clark Fork River starting July 22 . Temperatures were measured at the USGS gage 12352500 near Missoula. Water temperatures exceeded 73 degrees in this reach of the Bitterroot River for three consecutive days starting July 17.

blackfoot.name: Blackfoot River
blackfoot.message: Closed to floating from Weigh Station Fishing Access Site downstream to the point where the river crosses under Interstate 90, beginning July 15 due to construction on a railway bridge. More information Map (PDF)

clark-fork.name: Clark Fork River
clark-fork.message: Hoot owl restrictions (fishing prohibited 2:00 p.m. to midnight) are in effect for the Clark Fork River - from the Clark Fork’s origin at the confluence of Warm Springs Creek and Silver Bow Creek to the confluence of the Blackfoot River starting July 29 . Temperatures were measured at the USGS Clark Fork gauge 12324200 at Deer Lodge. Water temperatures exceeded 73 degrees in this reach of the Clark Fork River for three consecutive days starting July 17th.
